import sqlite3, json, sys

conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/world.db")
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cur = conn.cursor()

# List all tables
cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")
tables = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
print("TABLES:", tables)

# List all users
cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10")
users = [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchall()]
for u in users:
    print("USER:", json.dumps(u, default=str))

# Find orders with 9497
cur.execute("SELECT * FROM orders")
all_orders = [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchall()]
print("TOTAL ORDERS:", len(all_orders))
for o in all_orders:
    print("ORDER:", o.get("order_id"), o.get("status"), o.get("user_id"))

# Get order items
cur.execute("SELECT * FROM order_items LIMIT 20")
items = [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchall()]
for i in items:
    print("ITEM:", json.dumps(i, default=str))

# Get payments
cur.execute("SELECT * FROM order_payments LIMIT 20")
payments = [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchall()]
for p in payments:
    print("PAYMENT:", json.dumps(p, default=str))

conn.close()
print("DONE")
